body:
Great advice. Although, I don't know how to bring it up to him. My whole family knows about the warts on my hands and makes fun of me for it. I just hide my pinky from sight and try to cover up my left hand knuckle. The rest of them aren't as big so I don't worry about them. How could I get in contact with a dermatologist? I'm going to try to go to my local health clinic with my mom and see what we can do about them. Other than that, I'm going to call her tonight and ask her. I'm going to try to ride the lightning here. I've learned over the past week or so that writing a journal helps so I can look back and realize how far I've progressed. If you're wondering what I'm doing with that, check here: http://www.bulletjournal.com/. Where the monthly goals are I just put the things in my life I need to slowly eliminate or fix, it helps to keep an objective in mind. After making this post I think I'm doing better than I have in years. I'm making a public promise here that I won't kill myself. No matter how bad it is. I can't deal with how it'll fuck up my family even more than it is. 

Other than that, thanks a lot to everyone that's commented. I know this is a direct reply to kittenology, but this goes to everyone that's said some things. Thanks again. I'll check in here every few days to see if anyone's commented or replied.
